animations.title: 1 · Carefree
animations.label: Carefree
animations.action: All three heads have soft happy closed-arc eyes and easy smiles; loose ears, a relaxed upright stance. A small buoyant shoulder lift and lazy wide tail sway, then contented blink. Utterly carefree, zero stress, no tension.
animations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: eight-frame retro pixel Cerberus reaction sprite sheet for an animation asset gallery.
Reference image: supplied official character 01e is the STRICT character identity, palette and pixel-style reference. Animate the same creature; do not redesign it.

Exactly FOUR legs, two brown-charcoal striped FRONT legs and two golden HIND legs. Exactly THREE individually recognizable attached tails at the right rump, tall golden swept tail, orange/cream curled Pom plume and shorter dark striped cat tail. All heads, four legs/paws and all three tails remain complete in all eight frames. No collars/accessories. Do not duplicate limbs, detach heads or turn it into three animals.
Style: same coarse stepped pixel silhouette and thick dark-brown stepped outlines as 01e, natural orange/golden/cream/charcoal coat palette, flat pixel-cluster shading, tiny simple pixel features. Expression changes are conveyed by pixel eyelids, brows, mouth, ears and posture. No palette/color change with stress, no gradients, no smooth vector edges, no realistic fur.
Layout: landscape 2:1 PNG, exactly FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows, EIGHT square cells in a strict invisible grid. Frame order left-to-right top row 1-4 then bottom row 5-8. NO grid lines, text, numbers, labels, captions, watermark, scenery, floor or cast shadow. Actual transparent alpha background; cream fur remains opaque.

Nothing crosses cell boundaries or touches canvas edges. SAME camera, three-quarter orientation as reference, SAME character scale, shared torso anchor and foot baseline across all frames, no camera zoom/rotation/translation.

Do NOT return to neutral at the end. No props, emoji, exclamation marks, hearts, symbols, sweat drops or extra objects. Changes must be visible in facial expressions AND ears/tails/body posture; all three heads share the specified stress level, each recognizable as its species.
